basis.basis_description: Pilot design inputs: two discrete dimensions per axis; second value is 1.1 times the merged reference dimension. Box loading and its centre of gravity follow the merged public solver script. Analytic ship mass and inertia use a homogeneous solid closed at the waterplane, with the centre of gravity at its volume centroid. No measured loading is asserted.
basis.irregular_frequency_band_reason: Assumed screening range from 1 percent below to 3 percent above the estimated interior mode, with inclusive edges. The affected range reaches at least +2.2 percent above the estimate; the retained box_00 and box_04 samples bound the lower side. The band edges have not been measured.
basis.ship_inertia_method: Signed tetrahedral integrals about the waterplane origin, where lid moments vanish, transferred to the uniform-density volume centroid by the parallel-axis theorem; the wetted radiation mesh is unchanged.

convergence.scope: Head-sea heave at the three reference sample frequencies only

criteria.benchmark: Merged open-source no-lid box heave at the three recorded sample frequencies, head seas; identical dimensions, mesh, gravity, density, depth, centre of mass and gyradii
criteria.criterion_basis: Beforehand pilot screening inputs, not a standard-derived allowance or experimental uncertainty. Each benchmark response must satisfy absolute difference <= absolute tolerance + relative tolerance * abs(reference). Finest-pair head-sea heave change must satisfy the convergence absolute tolerance.
criteria.scope: Reproduction of an already-merged open-source calculation and limited panel sensitivity, not independent experimental validation
